content.impact: 현재 저장소에서 대응하는 canonical Specification을 확인하지 못했으므로 후속 Work Unit에서 review facade의 상태 및 표시 계약을 Specification으로 정렬해야 한다.

content.title: Sanitized conversational review facade
scope: Add a Main-Agent-facing review projection keyed by Work Unit id.
Read canonical Work Unit status and report evidence through owning managers.
Render Human-safe summary and map rework or complete to existing lifecycle operations.
Redact internal script names, absolute paths, raw protocol payloads, branches, and commits from default output.
dependencies: Define atomic ordering for complete plus integration so failure cannot produce a false done state.
verification: Manager-level contract tests should cover sanitization, rework revision, complete success, and integration failure; execution requires separate explicit Human test authorization.

content.title: Dedicated local review viewer and split integration state
scope: Add a local viewer using opaque Work Unit review tokens or ids.
Provide changed-file navigation, rendered artifact previews, verification evidence, accessibility, expiry, and explicit diagnostic disclosure.
Introduce accepted, integrating, integrated, and integration-failed orchestration states if Human needs approval separated from integration.
dependencies: Requires threat model, local server lifecycle, artifact renderer policy, stale-review handling, and rollback/new-Work-Unit rules.
tradeoffs: Better discoverability and rich inspection at substantially higher implementation and security cost.
